_metadata.description: OT-P1-003 — versioned trigger policy, durable incidents, and bounded automatic composition.

requirements.title: Versioned investigation policy and incident identity
requirements.description: Plan Manager shall validate versioned shadow or automatic trigger policy, evaluate bounded progress rules with exclusions and limits, and persist one deduplicated incident fingerprint with the effective policy version.

validation.notes: Focused policy tests cover rule defaults, exclusions, cooldown, budget, and shadow behavior.
Incident fingerprint persistence and manual linkage are idempotent.

requirements.title: Automatic bounded composition
requirements.description: In automatic mode, one eligible incident shall compose the declared plan-manager.investigate program through Program Runtime with explicit execution, phase, question, brief, and run IDs, persist the returned program identity, and preserve retry-safe caller identity on dispatch failure or acknowledgement loss.

validation.notes: Handler seam proves one automatic composition, durable program linkage, and duplicate-record suppression. Live Program Runtime and policy smoke receipts are retained in the plan evidence index.
